storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/nwsalerts/ (gz after 2 days)
license: US government work, public domain; attribution 'National Weather Service'. Contact User-Agent sent per api.weather.gov policy.

field_map.id: NWS alert message id (dedup key — messages are immutable; updates arrive as NEW ids)
field_map.event: alert type (Tornado Warning, Winter Storm Watch, ...)
field_map.lat/lon: polygon centroid when the alert carries geometry; null for zone-coded alerts
field_map.bbox: [W,S,E,N] of the alert polygon, or null

confidence_model: RAW official warnings, no derived quantities. GEOMETRY HONESTY: zone-coded alerts (geometry:null upstream) archive with null centroid/bbox and are COUNTED (zone_only) in the live payload — a visible cap; zone-polygon resolution is a filed follow-up. Full polygons are NOT archived (space) — centroid+bbox only; display rings are decimated live.
